applied.old: ⚠️ CRITICAL MEDICAL DISCLAIMER:DMSO Safety: You should use 99.9% Pharmaceutical Grade DMSO, ideally in a glass bottle. It's sold on Amazon and other sites (I've never had a bad batch of DMSO). Ensure hands, lungs, and nose are clean before using. See my [full DMSO reference](http://dmso.u-dont-exist.com/) here.
applied.new: DMSO Safety: This protocol has you smell DMSO for anxiety and brain fog. It's a solvent that goes straight through your skin and lungs into your blood, and it can carry in whatever else is in the bottle or on your skin. So you should use 99.9% Pharmaceutical Grade DMSO, ideally in a glass bottle, since it can leach chemicals out of some plastics. It's sold on Amazon and other sites (I've never had a bad batch). Before using it, wash any lotions or other products off your hands and nose. Your lungs count too, so if you're a smoker, breathe in only a little at a time, since it can pull the tar from your lungs into your blood, and stop if you feel weak right afterwards, which is the first sign of that (there's more on all this in my [full DMSO reference](http://dmso.u-dont-exist.com/)).

applied.old: Electrolytes: Consult a doctor if you have kidney disease or heart conditions.
applied.new: Electrolytes: This protocol has you eating [a lot more potassium](https://ibogaqueen.substack.com/i/181671197/1-electrolytes-choose-your-path) than most people get, so consult a doctor first if you have kidney disease or heart conditions, or take a blood pressure drug that holds on to potassium. Those are the ACE inhibitors and ARBs, and with either kind, or with weak kidneys, potassium can build up in your blood.

applied.new: Ethnobotanicals: The plant medicines in this protocol are iboga (an African root bark) and psilocybin mushrooms. Both are illegal in many jurisdictions and carry risks, and iboga's are the serious ones, since it can be dangerous for your heart and nervous system. So never combine Iboga with most medications (especially heart & psych meds), and if you take any, check it against my full [iboga guide here](http://iboga.u-dont-exist.com/) first (the iboga [microdosing protocol is here](http://ibogamicroprotocol.u-dont-exist.com/)).

applied.old: The armored brain projects its own internal threat level onto neutral faces. You will think people are judging you; in reality, they are just thinking about themselves. Rule: During this protocol, do not trust your social intuition. It is calibrated to "Threat," not "Truth." Assume you are misreading every room until your heart rate is back down to your usual resting rate, and under 90 BPM.
applied.new: Your armored brain also reads the threat it feels into neutral faces, so you will think people are judging you when they're mostly just thinking about themselves. So during this protocol, do not trust your social intuition: assume you are misreading every room, at least until your heart rate is back down to your usual resting rate, and under 90 BPM, since a racing heart means your reasoning brain is offline (see the ["Metabolic Red Line"](https://ibogaqueen.substack.com/i/181671197/a-the-metabolic-red-line) below).

applied.move: the 5-HTP rule, the post's sentence unchanged, from the head of the uridine paragraph to the end of the 5-HTP paragraph
applied.old: Uridine & 5-HTP Warning for Psychedelic Users: These are not "trip enhancers." They are repair-oriented levers that, in practice, can change brain sensitivity quickly. 5-HTP is serotonergic because it is a direct serotonin precursor. Do not combine it with SSRIs, SNRIs, MAOIs, linezolid, lithium, tramadol, methadone, fentanyl, DXM, MDMA, St. John's wort, SAM-e, L-tryptophan, or other serotonin-raising stacks. Be especially conservative around ayahuasca / harmalas because MAO-A inhibition can amplify serotonin load, and around iboga / ibogaine because ibogaine and noribogaine interact with serotonin transport biology and already carry serious cardiac and neurological risk.
applied.new: Uridine & 5-HTP Warning for Psychedelic Users: These are not "trip enhancers." They are repair-oriented levers that, in practice, can change brain sensitivity quickly. 5-HTP is serotonergic because it is a direct serotonin precursor. Do not combine it with SSRIs, SNRIs, MAOIs, linezolid, lithium, tramadol, methadone, fentanyl, DXM, MDMA, St. John's wort, SAM-e, L-tryptophan, or other serotonin-raising stacks. Be especially conservative around ayahuasca / harmalas because MAO-A inhibition can amplify serotonin load, and around iboga / ibogaine because ibogaine and noribogaine interact with serotonin transport biology and already carry serious cardiac and neurological risk. Rule: do not take 5-HTP on the same day as a psychedelic trip, and do not use it anywhere near ayahuasca/harmalas or iboga.

applied.old: Rule: do not take 5-HTP on the same day as a psychedelic trip, and do not use it anywhere near ayahuasca/harmalas or iboga. Uridine is not serotonergic, but it may still change dream vividness, visual sensitivity, craving, and psychedelic tolerance; that's from experience, like Scott's below, not from studies. Do not take UMP on the same day as a psychedelic trip; if sensitivity changes, assume your old psychedelic dose may now be too high.
applied.new: Uridine (the UMP in this protocol) doesn't raise serotonin, so its caution is a different one, and it comes from experience like [Scott's below](https://ibogaqueen.substack.com/i/181671197/dopamine-receptor-burnout-daws-pattern-uridine-monophosphate), since I don't have studies on it: within a day of starting it, psychedelics can hit harder, visuals included. So do not take UMP on the same day as a psychedelic trip, and on your first trip after starting it, assume your old psychedelic dose may now be too high and take less. It may also make your dreams more vivid and your cravings weaker, which are the benefits you're hoping for.
